93 Appendix D — Local test reference

Bangla name: লোকাল টেস্ট রেফারেন্স

← Contents · Coverage

One row per feature: can you test this locally, and if not, why. Every feature file has its own §11 developer test guide with the concrete steps; this page is the index that tells you which of those guides will actually get you somewhere.

1. The setup documents

Do not start here. Start here, then come back:

Document Covers
docs/local-dev.md The whole backend stack: PostgreSQL, Redis, DynamoDB Local, Floci (Cognito, S3, SQS, SES, DynamoDB), the nine services under Aspire, seeding, teardown
docs/mobile-local.md Both Flutter apps: tools, devices, how they reach the backend, and §8 known gaps
docs/admin-portal-local.md The admin portal (it runs from a local copy, not the submodule)
docs/user-portal-local.md The user portal, including the /p/identity and /p/oneid stubs
docs/config-reference.md Every configuration key
docs/local-dev-setup.bn.md The setup manual in Bangla
postman/ Service collections and local environments
scripts/ user-secrets.example.json, seed SQL, Set-EtpSecrets.ps1

2. What is dummy in the local stack

Everything below is stubbed. This single table explains most "Partial" ratings in §3.

External Local value Consequence
DgePay dummy Order creation works; the payment page and callback do not
TSP (VDS) https://tsp.invalid/…, no certificate Tickets reach Requested but are never signed — blocks S-08, S-09, P-08, C-03
OneID fake at /p/oneid Login works; ticket sync does not (P-10)
NBR VAT https://*.invalid The VAT message retries for ever (S-10)
Identity API 503 stub, or /p/identity Registration, OTP, profile and delete cannot be tested properly (Q-01)
Serverless API https://serverless.invalid/ Customer name/phone lookups return empty (Q-03)
Notification service https://notification.invalid/ Every SMS fails (Q-05)
Firebase dummy No push is ever delivered
CloudFront signed cookie local-dummy Admin-portal file protection fails locally (X-20)
SES Floci SES, noreply@etp.local Sends are accepted; no real mail (X-21)

What Floci does provide, and is real: Cognito (all four pools), S3 (bucket etp-local), SQS (real queue semantics), SES, DynamoDB Local, PostgreSQL and Redis.

4. Summary

Rating Count Of 103
Full 60 58%
Partial 35 34%
Not locally 8 8%

Almost every "Partial" is caused by one of the ten dummies in §2, and almost every "Not locally" is caused by the identity API, OneID, DgePay or the missing Amplify-Floci bridge. None of them is a defect in the code — they are limits of the local environment, which is what a local environment is for.

5. The five things worth testing first

If you have one afternoon and want to see the most behaviour per minute:

# Do this Shows you
1 Seed the data, open the user portal, browse to an event and open the seat map The whole read path: Event, Booking, Redis capacity
2 Create a booking order and watch the Redis lock appear, then watch S-03 clean it up Capacity locking, the RedLock worker, and the Q-10 key bug
3 Run the checker app's manual entry path (C-04) The weakest validation in the product, and Q-75
4 Post to the chat REST endpoint without a token Q-46 — the most serious finding, reproducible in one request
5 Stop Redis, then restart a service Why X-25 calls Redis a hard dependency
